story: BMW Loses Core Development Team of Its I3 and I8 Electric Vehicle Line
text: There was a video ( [VIDEO] ) posted recently discussing the manufacturing tech within the i3; absolutely fascinating - the general gist being how this car is the Model T of our time. Perhaps it is a big loss or not that great; eitherway I believe the company will do just fine - they've set themselves up very well for the future unlike many of the other manufacturers in terms of brand, mobility, innovating / delivering on new tech / processes etc.

story: A Company That Tears Cars Apart to Find Out How They're Built
text: I don't follow the car industry but I did happen to catch this 2015 video of Munro talking about the BMW i3. He says things like "this is the watershed," "they invented new science," "this is the Model T of our time," etc. I got a whole new respect for BMW after watching that video. Munro even followed the production chain to Morocco while investigating the costing! [VIDEO]

story: Volkswagen and the Blame the Engineer Game
text: If anybody is interested in this kind of thing, here is an hour-long talk with a freelance analyst who disassembled the BMW i3: [VIDEO] His agency is selling that report for $500,000. I found the whole thing quite fascinating.
